denosumab (Prolia, 2010) was authorised before the AMNOG early benefit assessment (2011): no IQWiG dossier

melatonin for primary insomnia (Circadin, 2007) predates AMNOG; Slenyto's 2018 dossier concerns children
no NICE technology appraisal of ferric carboxymaltose (heart failure is covered by guideline NG106)
